name: Butterfly chart (vertical)
purpose: Same contract as Chart-butterfly-h, rotated: two-series comparison per category as mirrored columns above/below one shared horizontal baseline — e.g. actual versus forecast by quarter. Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, behaviour AND geometry by the generated dv-render engine partials (ADR-0015; the marks are drawn at runtime from a DATA spec, not baked). CHART-EXPANSION WAVE 2 lane 1 (2026-08-05); ported from Chart-bar.reference.html's column x-geometry (REUSED verbatim) and Chart-line.reference.html's Layer-2 state model. Meta notes cross-reference Chart-butterfly-h.meta.json by DIVVY instruction; the two snippet files are independent.
when: answers=comparison AND series=2 mirrored above/below ONE horizontal baseline AND the category axis is ordered left-to-right (time, rank) AND span.cols ≥ 8 — yields to Chart-butterfly-h (40, "exactly two series mirrored, categories ≥ 6") whenever the categories are unordered or the panel is narrower than 8 cols; both yield to chart-bar for an ordinary grouped comparison.

not-with.when: the Stat-card makes the identical claim in the same view

props.name: series
props.$note: Exactly two series, one per direction. UP takes data/series/1 (column default, DV-D09); DOWN takes data/series/3, paired for visual contrast with the -h sibling's LEFT/RIGHT choice.

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: mirrored vertical, two series
variants.use: Compare two measures per category over a category axis that reads left-to-right (time, rank), both directions on the SAME scale so the halves stay comparable.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class (DV-D08): .t-cm-chart-label / .t-cm-chart-value = 12/500 · table .t-cm-legal 12/400 · title .t-cm-section-label
tokens.series: UP = data/series/1, DOWN = data/series/3; high-contrast remap data/series-1-hc / data/series-3-hc (data-contrast="high")
tokens.axis: DECLARED GAP (ds-020, DIVVY-instructed): Chart-bar's DV-D07 two-channel axis/grid CSS role is NOT ported. The one shared baseline carries colour via inline stroke="var(--baseline)" only, no gridlines drawn at all.
tokens.elevation: table popover + value tip = surface ground + elevation/functional shadow + elevation/border (anchored-overlay recipe, same as Chart-bar)
tokens.$survey: x-geometry (6-slot layout, all data-fx/data-fw fractions) is IDENTICAL to Chart-bar's column chart — reused verbatim, only the baseline y and the up/down y math are new. #260: that hand-derived geometry is RETIRED — dv-render-butterfly.js owns the arithmetic and the author owns the data. Layer-2 machinery is injected, not merely referenced.

motion.entry: Columns grow from the shared baseline (scaleY, transform-box:fill-box) — UP grows from its bottom edge (data-grow="up", bar's own convention, reused unmodified), DOWN grows from its top edge (data-grow="down", new keyframe dvGrowYD), 760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 45ms per-column stagger, CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: brightness(1.12) light / (1.22) dark on the bar; legend hover/focus fades the other active series 24%, peeks a ghosted one at 24% (DV-D11, once dv-legend.js is wired).
motion.reducedMotion: Entry inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

behaviour.fallback: With CSS on and JS off the canvas renders as an EMPTY <svg> and no butterfly is drawn — dvRender is what fills it. The data is not lost and is not unlabelled: the figure carries a real <table class="dv-table"> inside a native <details>/<summary> disclosure (s116-D2), authored in the markup and not generated, so the six quarters, actual and forecast open, read and copy with no script at all (dv-005 tabular alternative + the a11y spine). The engine REWRITES those same rows from the spec when it runs, so the popover value and the table value are one number by construction. Lost with JS off: the value popover, the responsive fit reflow (the fixed 580px canvas + horizontal scroll is the DV-D02 static answer), the DV-D11 legend filter/isolate and Copy CSV.
behaviour.$note: Typed #260 (the s259-D1 fast-follower lane). `script` addresses the ENGINE CORE — dv-render.js is the file a consumer's behaviour begins at; dv-render-butterfly.js is reached through its type registry and is named in `partial`, which is where the registered AUTO-BEHAVIOUR names belong. ONE partial registers BOTH orientations (butterfly-h and butterfly-v): the two share the symmetric domain, the pair validation, the DV-D09 fill rule and the wing arithmetic, and only the axis assignment differs — the same argument dv-render-bar makes for its four types. dv-legend is injected and consumed (the two-wing legend runs on it) and is listed here, because unlike Chart-bar this member has exactly one canvas and the legend is part of its script chain. ⛔ SCRIPT ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: dv-render + dv-render-butterfly are injected ABOVE the dvRender() bootstrap and dv-legend BELOW it — dv-legend's rec() caches every mark once at parse time and would otherwise cache an empty canvas (measured at #259 on the donut).

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale text. data-pl="46" data-pr="12" — Chart-bar's own column margins, reused unmodified since the x-geometry is identical. data-fx/data-fw on rects, data-fx on the baseline and category labels.

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" with a full-sentence data aria-label reading both series per category.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; each bar carries aria-label + data-tip naming its category, series and value (popover value == table value, one source).
accessibility.keyboard: Bars are focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label → value popover on focus); legend rows are filter buttons (once dv-legend is wired); table toggle = dropdown (aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismiss → refocus).
accessibility.nonText: Both series fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016). DIRECTION (up/down) plus colour disambiguate the two series — on-chart letter keys deliberately OMITTED, same delta as the -h sibling, receipted there and repeated here.

antiPatterns: More than two series (the mirrored-baseline geometry only reads for a pair)
Different scales for the up and down halves (breaks the visual comparability a butterfly exists to give)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
